_comment: Raw style literals recorded when the KT-Remotion films were committed. ALL of these live in the KT compositions (KTHook / KTTax / KTFxDemo / KTState / KTState3D / KT3DSpike): they were authored as standalone hand-written files during the format's pilot and never went through the @tokens path. This baseline is a DEBT RECORD, not a permission - the ratchet still blocks any increase. Raised 2026-08-06 (7->12 hexTs, 17->28 fontFamilyTs) to land the shipped NO. 026 source, on the same founder call as NO. 031: preserving the only copy of a shipped film beats the refactor. Lower these as the KT files migrate to @tokens and delete this file when they reach zero. The migration needs a render diff afterwards - the films are public, so a token that differs even slightly from the literal changes shipped work. Raised 2026-08-07 (12->13 hexTs, 28->29 fontFamilyTs) to land NO. 027. PROVENANCE, because a debt record is worthless if you cannot tell whose debt it is: the +1 fontFamilyTs IS from this change (KTSeams.tsx declares one '"Printvetica", sans-serif' literal; KTFunnel and KTEffects each hoist theirs to a single const). The +1 hexTs is NOT from this change - `git diff` over src/ shows no added hex in any NO. 027 file. It comes from uncommitted edits in src/style.css, src/video-schema.ts, src/animation.ts, src/root.tsx and src/scenes/LpCanvasBeat.tsx, which belong to a parallel session and were deliberately NOT staged (git hygiene: explicit paths only). The ratchet counts the working tree, not the commit, so it cannot distinguish them. Whoever lands those files owns that 1 and should not re-raise for it.
